new_probes.setup: Inspect the real smoke test, Compose volume mount, Docker evidence, and final aggregate evidence.
new_probes.fault_injection: A nonpersistent or unavailable runtime data directory would lose the UUID marker across restart while a health-only check could still pass.
new_probes.production_trigger: The isolated Compose smoke writes the marker in /var/lib/reponpc, restarts app, waits for /healthz, and reads the exact marker back through docker compose exec.
new_probes.oracle: The exact marker remains readable after restart; EVID-P2-044, EVID-P2-045, and EVID-P2-046 all pass with the recorded artifact hash.
new_probes.anti_oracle: A successful health response or setup_required status without reading persisted runtime data does not prove volume retention.
new_probes.command: Read-only inspection plus Docker Desktop Compose config validation recorded in artifacts/gate-docker-persistence.txt
